name: Ani no Yome to Musume o Biyaku de Otosu Dake no Kantan na Oshigoto Desu.
original_name: 兄の嫁と娘を媚薬で堕とすだけの簡単なお仕事です。
source:
One day the protagonist gets a suspicious drug from his friend.
He uses it on his elder brother's wife Kozue doubting anything will happen...
It turns out to be a very strong aphrodisiac!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ219673.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
